parameters.content:
## FLOOWBOX - News Aggregator + Bias Detector
Runs every morning at 7 AM.
3 parallel Perplexity searches for same topics:
- Left/progressive outlet coverage
- Right/conservative outlet coverage
- Neutral wire service coverage
GPT-4o identifies framing differences and bias patterns.
Provides 'most neutral summary' of what actually happened.
Saves to Notion + Slack daily digest.
